response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished senior full-stack/web engineer with strong software craftsmanship, but their background is fundamentally misaligned with a Principal Performance Architect role focused on SoC/IP modeling, AI accelerator performance, and hardware-software co-design. There is no evidence of silicon architecture work, GPU/SIMD/MIMD experience, or deep-learning workload optimization; the closest relevant experience (low-latency DLang services, some embedded exposure, brief C/C++ IDE work) falls well short of the required hardware performance architecture expertise.
strengths: Strong systems programming exposure (DLang, C/C++, async I/O, low-latency services at scale)
Long, consistent engineering track record (~15+ years) meeting the years-of-experience bar with a BS in CS
Demonstrated initiative through open-source projects, workshops, and technical teaching
concerns: No SoC/IP modeling, chip architecture, or hardware-software co-design experience
No GPU, SIMD/MIMD, or AI accelerator performance analysis background
Career trajectory is web/product engineering, not hardware performance architecture at principal level

key_factors.factor: Lack of SoC/IP modeling and hardware architecture experience
No AI accelerator / GPU / deep-learning workload optimization background
Low-latency systems programming and performance-minded engineering
